name: Corporate Pilot
description: Twenty years flying executive shuttles, and you saved every credit. A comfortable start, but nobody writes songs about it.

name: Ex-Navy Officer
description: Discharged with a small pension and a habit of keeping ships in one piece. Starts with 2 spare parts.

name: Reformed Smuggler
description: You know every back channel between here and the Kuiper Belt, and you have almost nothing to your name. Starts with 30 fuel and 30 food. A hard start with a big reward.
